changes.newText: You can also chat with an OpenAI-compatible service that is not deployed on Backend.AI. Select Connect a custom endpoint… in the Deployment dropdown, enter the service's Base URL and, if the service requires one, an API key, then click Connect. The chat card then lists the models that service offers, and Edit custom endpoint reopens the form so you can change the address or the key.
